title: Downstairs private apartment w/pool and grill!
description:
POOL IS OPEN until mid Oct!!!
A great place to stay for a trip with friends or to bring the family! Comes with a 4ft x 4ft play pen and mat. Grill out during the day and play some lawn games then at night cozy up to a fire and roast some marshmallows!
We are located 25 mins from downtown Nashville, 20 mins from the Grand Ole Opry, 20 mins from the airport, 5 mins from multiple grocery stores, 10 mins from walking/biking trails and much more! 
All are welcome

Guest access
You have access to the fenced in pool (open May through September), grill, fireplace and outdoor dining area in the backyard. It is only shared with the upstairs apartment.

Other things to note
Please note this is a no smoking and no animals home!
